items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You have said...what did you say about Pete Townsend... You said he made “Young Man Blues” sound like an anthem.

ctx.x: You have said...what did you say about Pete Townsend... You said he made “Young Man Blues” sound like an anthem. You said something nice about it.
Well, the Who made everything sound like an anthem.
